description: This source file defines utilities and data structures related to launching and managing launchctl agents on macOS. It includes a method to run launchctl commands asynchronously, as well as structures to parse and represent launch agent plist snapshots.

classes.name: Launchctl
classes.description: A utility enum providing an asynchronous method to run launchctl commands.

classes.name: LaunchAgentPlist
classes.description: A utility enum for parsing launch agent plist files into snapshot representations.

classes.name: LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot
classes.description: A data structure representing a snapshot of relevant launch agent plist data.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the launchctl command with specified arguments asynchronously and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Reads and parses a launch agent plist file at a given URL into a snapshot object.
